paragraphs.text: Shade is a mainly black creature type used for cards that depict powerful spirits , beings of darkness, typically employed by evil wizards who wield large amounts of black mana . Shades are shadowy ghosts of dead people who linger on earth.

The first card to bear the type was Frozen Shade in Alpha . Shades are one of the creature types with the most consistent mechanical identity. The cards usually have a " pump " effect ( : This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn). Ihsan's Shade , Skyclave Shade , Author of Shadows and Ichor Shade are the only shades without a pumping ability. Oddly, the latter three were designed long after shades cemented their mechanical identity.
Since R&D has moved away from doing power/toughness pumping as much in black, the creation of Shades has also dwindled.

Most shades are black. Cinder Shade has red in its casting cost and is the only multicolored shade. Shade of Trokair from Planar Chaos is the only white Shade and has the white mana version of this ability. Chilling Shade uses snow mana rather than mana. Gateway Shade allows usage of gates rather than only black mana. Misery's Shadow is the least specific, allowing any mana at a 1:1 ratio.
Shade's Breath is an instant that turns creatures into Shades. Shade's Form is an enchantment that gives creatures Shade-abilities. The art shows a person in the process of changing into a shade.

Certain regions of Dominaria are inhabited by Frozen Shades, which are often enslaved by powerful sorcerers. Some were used as protectors of Caliphear the Nightmare ’s lands in the Great Salt Marshes of Western Golthonor . These Shades were defeated by goblins and Shanodin Dryads after the swamps became barren due to the wizard Coldraith ’s magic. Another Frozen Shade was summoned by Aldon using a dark amulet, along with a vampire and bog wraith . The shade needed to feed on flesh or would dissipate, so it joined with Dreygar in convincing Aldon to attack Dreygar's Castle . When Dreygar was killed, the bog wraith remained as an advisor to Aldon.
Rimewind Necromancers were known to create Chilling Shade s from the souls of those trapped in mystical blizzards. Furthermore, the Nantuko often become shades after their death.

Dread shades, known as remnants , served Belzenlok 's Cabal . They could change their sizes; not only could they become extremely large, but they could also shrink down small enough to crawl inside a corpse and animate it. They were gray figures, naked to the waist, their bodies like a muscular, desiccated corpse. Their chests have been ripped open from collar to their waists, revealing an empty cavity that glows with spectral light below a pointed face with a wide, fanged jaw.
Innistradi shades are known to live among humanity ( Evernight Shade ).

Some Condemners of the Legion of Dusk are Shade-Binders. They capture and magically bind Shades using blessed braziers that exude inky black smoke. These Revenants are used to guard ships and are sometimes bound in weapons.
Both the House Dimir and the Cult of Rakdos employ shades as servants, spies, and protectors. More feral shades are known to prowl the Undercity .
Ihsan's Shade is an infamous Shade on Ulgrotha , created by Baron Sengir .
Shades on Zendikar are often drawn to places of great power, where they establish their hunting grounds. Some vampires are shown to return after their death as shades ( Nirkana Revenant ).
